theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h1 : b ≥ 3 := hb
  have h2 : b = 3 := by
    have h3 : b ≤ 3 := le_of_not_gt (lt_iff_lt_right 3).1 h1
    exact eq_of_le_and_ge h3 h1
  subst h2
  have h4 : a * 3 = 12 := h
  rw [h4] at h4
  exact div_eq_of_mul_eq h4 (lt_iff_lt_right 3).1 h1
